title: Continuous Tremor Assessment During Daily Activities
brief_summary: The specific aim of this study is to evaluate if tremor severity and quality of life can be improved more using continuous home monitoring along with traditional assessments versus traditional assessments alone.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with essential tremor
* Currently taking medication to control tremor

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cognitive limitations that prevent comprehension or execution of study protocol
